\source("~/iCloud/code/R-markdown/init_insee.R")
# cd ~/iCloud/website/data/flags; /usr/local/bin/R -e 'quarto::quarto_render("index.qmd")'
# cd ~/iCloud/website/data/flags; sh _to_website.sh
load_data("flags/flagColors_data.RData")
load_data("flags/flagColors_json.RData")
load_data("flags/colors.RData")
source("flagColors.R")
flagColors_data <- flagColors_data %>%
  add_row(country = "Europe", c1 = "#003399", c2 = "#FFCC00") %>%
  add_row(country = "Hong Kong", c1 = "#DE2408", c2 = "#FFFFFF") %>%
  add_row(country = "OECD Members", c1 = "#96BA13", c2 = "#086199", c3 = "#AFCDDB", c4 = "#6F7173") %>%
  mutate_all(funs(ifelse(is.na(.), "", .)))
```

# Info

- Colorimètre numérique. [html](https://support.apple.com/fr-fr/guide/digital-color-meter/welcome/mac)

- RGB to HEX Color Converter. [html](https://www.rgbtohex.net)

# Palettes

```{r}
i_g("bib/R/color-palettes.png")
```

# colors

```{r}
colors %>%
  select(country, starts_with("c")) %>%
  mutate_at(vars(-country), funs(cell_spec(., color = .))) %>%
  mutate(Flag = gsub(" ", "-", str_to_lower(country)),
           Flag = paste0('<img src="../../icon/flag/vsmall/', Flag, '.png" alt="Flag">')) %>%
    select(Flag, everything()) %>%
  {if (is_html_output()) datatable(., filter = 'top', rownames = F, escape = F) else .}
```

# flagColors_data

## All

```{r}
flagColors_data %>%
  select(country, starts_with("c")) %>%
  mutate_at(vars(-country), funs(cell_spec(., color = .))) %>%
  mutate(Flag = gsub(" ", "-", str_to_lower(country)),
           Flag = paste0('<img src="../../icon/flag/vsmall/', Flag, '.png" alt="Flag">')) %>%
    select(Flag, everything()) %>%
  {if (is_html_output()) datatable(., filter = 'top', rownames = F, escape = F) else .}
```


## Eurozone

### Germany

```{r}
flagColors("Germany") %>%
  mutate(hex_c = cell_spec(hex, background = hex, color = hex)) %>%
  select(hex_c, everything()) %>%
  print_table_no_escape
```
